id: 11_Donning and Doffing PPE in Clinical Laboratories Removing Gown First and Gloves
title: 先脱隔离衣，再摘手套（国内版）
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/11_Donning and Doffing PPE in Clinical Laboratories Removing Gown First and Gloves.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/11_Donning and Doffing PPE in Clinical Laboratories Removing Gown First and Gloves（国内版）/src.py

points.K5: 口罩怎么选：看风险评估
points.K11: 手套压住袖口，再查一遍

shots.scene: 欣欣身穿隔离衣、戴口罩面屏，举起两根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot in a blue gown, face mask and face shield holds up two fingers at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：先脱隔离衣，再摘手套。

shots.scene: 隔离衣图标标①，手套图标标②
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a gown marked with a number one badge and a pair of gloves marked with a number two badge. No people.
shots.narration: 两步分开脱，步步不沾污。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着隔离衣，戴着手套，站在脱卸区犹豫
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a blue gown, gloves, mask and face shield stands in a doffing area looking unsure.
shots.narration: 阿杰上次学了衣服手套一起脱。

shots.scene: 阿杰的手套太紧，卡在袖子里拉不出来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student struggles as his tight gloves get stuck inside the gown sleeves.
shots.narration: 这次手套太紧，怎么也拉不出来。

shots.scene: 小研在旁边示意他停下，指着墙上空白流程图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calmly signals him to pause and points to a blank procedure chart on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研说：别硬拽，换一种脱法。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前微笑
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot smiles in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 先脱衣、后摘手套，一起来学。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着台上的隔离衣、手套、口罩、面屏
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a gown, gloves, a face mask and a face shield on a clean bench.
shots.narration: 装备还是隔离衣、手套、口罩、面屏。

shots.scene: 箭头从隔离衣指向手套
shots.prompt_en: An arrow pointing from a gown icon to a glove icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不同在于：脱时先衣服、后手套。

shots.scene: 阿杰把手表、手机、外套放进门外储物柜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his watch, phone and jacket into a locker outside the lab door.
shots.narration: 首饰、手表、手机、外套，留在门外。

shots.scene: 小研把长发扎起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties her long hair into a ponytail.
shots.narration: 头发长的，先扎好。

shots.scene: 后开式隔离衣与针织袖口特写
shots.prompt_en: A blue solid-front gown that wraps around the back, with knit cuffs. No people.
shots.narration: 前襟完整、针织袖口的隔离衣。

shots.scene: 一副手套、医用口罩和一次性面屏
shots.prompt_en: One pair of gloves, a flat medical face mask and a disposable face shield laid side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 一副手套，一个口罩，一个面屏。

shots.section_title: 口罩怎么选：看风险评估
shots.scene: 王老师手拿空白风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a clipboard with a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 医用口罩还是防护口罩，
overlay: 口罩怎么选：看风险评估

shots.section_title: 口罩怎么选：看风险评估
shots.scene: 评估表箭头指向两种口罩
shots.prompt_en: A blank risk assessment form with arrows to a flat medical face mask and a cup-shaped respirator. No people.
shots.narration: 由本实验室的风险评估来定。

shots.section_title: 口罩怎么选：看风险评估
shots.scene: 医用口罩图标被选中
shots.prompt_en: The flat medical face mask icon is highlighted with a green frame. No people.
shots.narration: 本课用医用口罩示范。

shots.scene: 小研挑选合身的隔离衣和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks a gown and a glove box with a blank label in her size.
shots.narration: 尺码挑合身的。

shots.scene: 放大镜下，松脱的系带和破洞打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass shows a loose strap and a small hole marked with red X icons. No people.
shots.narration: 撕裂、破洞、系带松脱，都换掉。

shots.scene: 小研穿上隔离衣，颈后系带
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on the gown and ties it behind her neck.
shots.narration: 穿上隔离衣，颈后、背后系牢。

shots.scene: 活结打勾，死结打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an easy bow with a green check and a hard knot crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 系活结，别勒太紧。

shots.scene: 小研穿好隔离衣，抬臂活动
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in the fastened gown raises and bends her arms freely.
shots.narration: 合身好活动，日常衣物不外露。

shots.scene: 小研戴上口罩，耳挂挂好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a medical face mask and hooks the ear loops behind her ears.
shots.narration: 戴口罩，挂好耳挂。

shots.scene: 食指按压鼻夹两侧
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: both index fingers press down on each side of the flexible nose piece. No people.
shots.narration: 按压鼻夹，让上缘贴紧。

shots.scene: 小研拉开头带，戴上面屏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stretches the strap and puts on a disposable face shield.
shots.narration: 戴面屏，头带套到脑后。

shots.scene: 海绵在眉毛上方，箭头标出三处覆盖
shots.prompt_en: Front view: the foam band rests above the eyebrows; arrows mark the forehead, below the chin and both sides. No people.
shots.narration: 盖住前额，过下巴，包住两侧。

shots.section_title: 手套压住袖口，再查一遍
shots.scene: 针织袖口拉到掌心，手套盖上
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the knit cuff is pulled down to the palm and a glove is pulled over it. No people.
shots.narration: 袖口拉到掌心，手套压在外面。
overlay: 手套压住袖口，再查一遍

shots.section_title: 手套压住袖口，再查一遍
shots.scene: 小研张开戴手套的手检查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student spreads her gloved fingers and looks for punctures.
shots.narration: 开工前，再确认手套没有破口。

shots.scene: 欣欣展示两张不同箭头的空白卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shows two blank cards with different arrow paths.
shots.narration: 下面演示的是其中一种方法。

shots.scene: 空白风险评估表、操作图标和装备图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank risk assessment form, a pipette and a gown linked to a blank procedure card. No people.
shots.narration: 方法和顺序，可按评估和操作调整。

shots.scene: 小研戴着手套解开腰带
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, still gloved, unties the waist strap of the gown.
shots.narration: 第一步脱隔离衣：解开腰带。

shots.scene: 双手抓肩向前拉，颈后系带松开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student grasps the gown at the shoulders and pulls forward; the neck strap comes loose behind.
shots.narration: 抓住两肩向前拉，领口松开。

shots.scene: 隔离衣从肩部向前脱下，离开身体
shots.prompt_en: The gown is drawn forward off her shoulders and held away from her body.
shots.narration: 从肩部往前脱，离身体远一点。

shots.scene: 隔离衣外面向内卷的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a gown rolling so its outside surface turns inward. No people.
shots.narration: 边脱边卷，外面翻进里面。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手捏住另一边袖子，从手套下拉出
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: one gloved hand pinches the opposite sleeve and pulls it out from under the other glove. No people.
shots.narration: 袖子快脱下时，从手套下面拉出来。

shots.scene: 手臂抽出，手套仍戴在手上
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the arm slides out of the sleeve and the glove stays on the hand. No people.
shots.narration: 手臂抽出，手套先留在手上。

shots.scene: 戴手套的双手把隔离衣卷成团
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands roll the gown inside out into a tight bundle, holding it away from the body.
shots.narration: 隔离衣里朝外卷成一团。

shots.scene: 衣团碰到日常衣物的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gown bundle touching street clothes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 脏的外面，别碰到日常衣物。

shots.scene: 衣团丢进感染性废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The gown bundle drops into a lined pedal bin marked with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 丢进感染性废物容器。

shots.scene: 戴手套的双手停在废物桶上方
shots.prompt_en: Two gloved hands held still above the open biohazard bin. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，再摘手套，慢一点轻一点。

shots.scene: 王老师指着空白规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank procedure document on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 摘手套也可按本单位的方法。

shots.scene: 拇指食指成L形，捏起另一只手套腕部外侧
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a gloved thumb and index finger form an L and pinch the outside of the other glove at the wrist. No people.
shots.narration: 捏起一只手套腕部的外侧。

shots.scene: 手套被整只拉下，翻成里朝外
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the glove is pulled off completely, ending up inside out. No people.
shots.narration: 整只拉下来，里朝外。

shots.scene: 翻面的手套握在仍戴手套的手里
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the inside-out glove is balled up in the palm of the still gloved hand. No people.
shots.narration: 把它握在戴手套的那只手里。

shots.scene: 裸手手指从内侧伸进剩下的手套腕口
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: bare fingers slide under the cuff of the remaining glove on the inside of the wrist. No people.
shots.narration: 裸手从手腕内侧伸进去。

shots.scene: 手套向上外翻，包住握着的那只
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the glove is peeled up and away from the wrist, turning inside out over the balled glove. No people.
shots.narration: 往上、往外翻下，两只包在一起。

shots.scene: 裸手抓手套外面的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand grabbing the outside of a dirty glove, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 干净的手，始终不碰手套外面。

shots.scene: 手套团丢进感染性废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The balled gloves drop into the lined biohazard pedal bin. No people.
shots.narration: 手套丢进感染性废物容器。

shots.scene: 把手套挂起晾干再用的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of used gloves hung up to dry for reuse, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一次性手套，用完不再用。

shots.scene: 小研挤出速干手消毒剂搓手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pumps alcohol hand rub from a bottle with a blank label and rubs her hands.
shots.narration: 接着手消毒。

shots.scene: 洗手池和新手套两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a sink with soap and a new pair of gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 或者洗手，或者换上新手套。

shots.scene: 小研低头，捏住头带
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tilts her head forward and holds the face shield strap above her ears.
shots.narration: 摘面屏：头前倾，捏住头带。

shots.scene: 面屏被轻轻提离面部
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the face shield is lifted gently up and away from the face by its strap. No people.
shots.narration: 轻轻提起，不碰前面的屏片。

shots.scene: 面屏丢进感染性废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The face shield drops into the lined biohazard bin. No people.
shots.narration: 丢进感染性废物容器。

shots.scene: 小研取下口罩耳挂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the ear loops of her mask off both ears.
shots.narration: 摘口罩：只捏耳挂。

shots.scene: 口罩移开丢进废物桶，摸口罩正面的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The mask held by its loops drops into the biohazard bin; a small icon of a hand on the mask front is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 外面不碰，离开面部就丢掉。

shots.scene: 小研用肥皂和流水洗手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes her hands with soap under running water.
shots.narration: 最后，肥皂流水洗手。

shots.scene: 手背、指缝、指甲下被圈出
shots.prompt_en: Soapy hands with the backs, the spaces between fingers and under the nails circled. No people.
shots.narration: 手背、指缝、指甲下都搓到。

shots.scene: 速干手消毒剂瓶，箭头指向洗手池
shots.prompt_en: A hand rub bottle with an arrow pointing to a sink with running water. No people.
shots.narration: 没水时先用手消，有水再洗。

shots.scene: 包头鞋打勾，凉鞋打叉
shots.prompt_en: A closed-toe shoe with a solid upper with a green check and an open sandal crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 穿包头、鞋面不透水的鞋。

shots.scene: 空白风险评估表连着防护装备图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank risk assessment form connected by arrows to gown, mask and glove icons. No people.
shots.narration: 穿哪些防护，按风险评估定。

shots.scene: 平面图：穿戴区与脱卸区隔开
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan with a donning area and a separate doffing area with a wall between them. No people.
shots.narration: 穿戴区、脱卸区分开。

shots.scene: 王老师指着墙上空白流程图
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank procedure chart on the wall.
shots.narration: 流程以本单位规定为准。

shots.scene: 两条不同的脱卸路线图标，其中一条被选中
shots.prompt_en: Two path icons for doffing; one is selected with a green frame and copied onto a blank procedure document. No people.
shots.narration: 两种脱法，实验室要先选定一种。

shots.scene: 老周在空白规程上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank procedure document at his desk.
shots.narration: 写进本实验室的操作规程。

shots.scene: 临场换来换去的箭头图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of zigzag arrows switching between two paths, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 大家统一做，不要临场乱换。

shots.scene: 两层手套的剖面示意
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section diagram of a hand wearing two layers of gloves, the outer glove over the gown cuff. No people.
shots.narration: 风险较高时，可能要戴双层手套。

shots.scene: 外层手套沾污，被换成新的外层
shots.prompt_en: A soiled outer glove is removed and a new outer glove is pulled on over the clean inner glove. No people.
shots.narration: 外层脏了，只换外层，内层继续护手。

shots.scene: 小研对照空白规程检查手套层次
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks her two glove layers against a blank procedure card.
shots.narration: 戴几层、怎么脱，按规程来。

shots.scene: 穿衣镜前，小研检查自己的穿戴
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks her gown, mask and face shield in a full-length mirror.
shots.narration: 穿好后，对着镜子查一遍。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研互相检查背后系带
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student check each other's gown ties from behind.
shots.narration: 同伴互相看，背后最容易漏。

shots.scene: 墙上张贴的空白流程图，步骤用数字图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank step chart on the wall next to the doffing area, with numbered icons only. No people.
shots.narration: 脱卸区贴流程图，照着一步步做。

shots.scene: 王老师在培训室指导学生演练
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator watches students practice putting on and taking off gowns in a training room.
shots.narration: 先练熟、经考核，再进实验室。

shots.scene: 针头、玻片、毛细管图标，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a needle, a glass slide and a capillary tube with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 临床样品常有针头、玻片等锐器。

shots.scene: 阿杰手指被扎，立即到水池用流水冲洗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, his gloved finger pricked, goes straight to the sink and rinses the finger under running water.
shots.narration: 被扎伤，立刻在流水下冲洗。

shots.scene: 手指从近心端向伤口轻挤的示意，再涂消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a finger with an arrow gently squeezing toward the wound, then a disinfectant swab icon. No people.
shots.narration: 从近心端向伤口轻挤，再消毒。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告，老周拿出空白登记表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man, who takes out a blank incident form.
shots.narration: 马上报告负责人，登记经过。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 尽快就医评估，紧急拨打120。

shots.scene: 锐器盒图标打勾，回套针帽的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A sharps container with a green check, and an icon of recapping a needle by hand crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 锐器直接进锐器盒，不回套针帽。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现隔离衣和手套图标，分别标①②
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a gown marked one and gloves marked two.
shots.narration: 先脱隔离衣，袖子从手套下抽出。

shots.scene: 翻脱手套的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a glove being peeled off inside out over another glove. No people.
shots.narration: 再翻脱手套，干净手不碰外面。

shots.scene: 手消毒、面屏、口罩、洗手顺序图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons linked by arrows: hand rub, face shield, mask, hand washing at a sink. No people.
shots.narration: 手消毒、摘面屏、摘口罩、洗手。

shots.scene: 镜子、规程、锐器盒三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a mirror, a blank procedure document and a sharps container. No people.
shots.narration: 统一规程、勤演练，锐器要当心。

shots.scene: 欣欣洗完手挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot dries its paws with a paper towel beside the sink and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 一步一步脱，安全每一步，下次见！
